5e137eaca67cd448.description: Commodity Trader | Riyadh, Saudi Arabia What This Role Is About Our client, a leading food and FMCG group, is looking for a Commodity Trader, based in Riyadh, with solid experience in agricultural commodities and a strong understanding of global commodity markets. 5e162e1ae955bf4d.description: Job description As a Service Manager for truck maintenance within the market research industry, you will play a vital role in overseeing the operational excellence of our service department. This position is designed for an individual who is passionate about ensuring that our clients' trucking fleets are maintained to the highest standards. You will lead a dedicated team focused on delivering exceptional maintenance services, ensuring that our clients receive reliable insights and solutions that enhance their operational efficiency. In this role, you will be immersed in a collaborative environment that values innovation and continuous improvement. You will work closely with your team to develop and implement maintenance strategies that not only meet but exceed client expectations. Our company is committed to providing ample opportunities for professional growth, including training programs and workshops tailored to the latest advancements in truck maintenance and service management. This is your chance to grow your career while making a significant impact on the trucking industry. Your leadership as a Service Manager will be instrumental in shaping the future of our maintenance services. You will guide your team in addressing the unique challenges of truck maintenance, ensuring they are equipped with the latest tools and best practices. This role offers a unique blend of strategic oversight and hands-on involvement, allowing you to influence both the operational and strategic aspects of our service offerings while advancing your career in a thriving sector. Responsibilities: Lead and manage a team of maintenance professionals, ensuring they are trained and equipped to deliver high-quality truck maintenance services to our clients. Develop and implement maintenance strategies that align with client needs, focusing on preventive and corrective maintenance to enhance fleet reliability. Monitor and analyze maintenance performance metrics to identify areas for improvement and implement necessary changes to enhance service quality and efficiency. Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including parts and inventory management, to ensure seamless service integration and alignment with overall business objectives. Conduct regular training sessions for team members on the latest maintenance techniques, tools, and industry best practices to ensure high standards of service delivery. Establish and maintain strong relationships with key clients, acting as a trusted advisor to ensure their maintenance needs are met effectively and efficiently. Oversee budgeting and resource allocation for maintenance operations, ensuring efficient use of resources to maximize service profitability and client satisfaction. Implement technology solutions to streamline maintenance processes, utilizing software for scheduling, tracking, and reporting to improve operational efficiency. Prepare and present maintenance performance reports to senior management, highlighting achievements, challenges, and strategic recommendations for future initiatives. Skills Strong leadership skills to effectively manage and motivate a diverse maintenance team. Excellent communication abilities to engage with clients and stakeholders at all levels in the trucking industry. Proficiency in truck maintenance techniques and methodologies to deliver insightful and effective service solutions. Analytical skills to evaluate maintenance performance metrics and drive continuous improvements in service delivery. Project management expertise to oversee multiple maintenance initiatives simultaneously while ensuring timely execution. Problem-solving skills to address client maintenance issues and implement effective solutions tailored to their needs. Technical proficiency in using maintenance management software and tools to enhance operational efficiency and service tracking.

5e39db4cfa20168a.job_title: Subject Matter Expert - Gear Pump (Polymer Processing) - Short Term 3 Months
5e39db4cfa20168a.description: We are seeking an experienced Gear Pump Subject Matter Expert (SME) with more than 20 years of experience in polymer processing plants and polymer equipment. The successful candidate will provide specialized technical expertise in the removal, installation, overhauling, troubleshooting, commissioning, and operation of MAAG Vacorex VX450/560 gear pumps and associated polymer processing equipment. Provide specialist recommendations and practical guidance to the maintenance and turnaround teams. Proven hands-on experience in gear pump removal, installation, troubleshooting, lifting, cleaning, and testing. Direct experience with MAAG Vacorex VX450/560 gear pump overhauling. Experience with DOW solution technology for commissioning, start-up, and normal operation. Experience with packing replacement and timing gear adjustment. Working knowledge of gearboxes, extruders, pelletizers, and polymer plant back-end systems.

5e15a1e4f560c741.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة مدائن المستقبل للطاقة عن أخصائي مبيعات للانضمام إلى فريقها في الدمام، بالمنطقة الشرقية. هذا الدور بدوام كامل ومخصص للمرشحين ذوي الخبرة من 0 إلى 1 سنة، ويركز على تطوير وتنفيذ استراتيجيات المبيعات وتقييم أدائها لضمان تحقيق الأهداف المحددة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية دراسة ومتابعة تطورات السوق لتحديد وتطوير الأهداف التسويقية وطرق البيع. تقدير حجم المبيعات المتوقع وترجمة الأهداف إلى خطط بيعية قابلة للتنفيذ. اقتراح سياسات البيع ومتابعة تنفيذها وتقييم البرامج الترويجية. التواصل الفعال مع العملاء لتحديد مشكلاتهم ومتابعة المنافسين وبرامجهم البيعية. تقييم نتائج أداء مندوبي البيع ومدى تحقيق الأهداف البيعية، واقتراح الإجراءات التصحيحية. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بالمبيعات، وتقديم التوصيات والحلول المناسبة. حفظ الوثائق والتقارير في قاعدة البيانات الخاصة بها وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال المبيعات أو مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على وضع سياسات البيع ومتابعة تنفيذها وتقييم النتائج. مهارات تحليلية قوية لدراسة السوق وتحديد الأهداف. المهارات والكفاءات مهارات تواصل ممتازة للتفاعل مع العملاء والمنافسين. القدرة على إعداد وتقديم التقارير المتخصصة بوضوح ودقة. مهارات حل المشكلات واقتراح الحلول المناسبة. الالتزام بالسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة في العمل. بيئة العمل يقع مقر العمل في مدينة الدمام بالمنطقة الشرقية، وهو دور بدوام كامل ضمن فريق المبيعات في شركة مدائن المستقبل للطاقة. يتيح هذا الدور فرصة للمساهمة في تطوير استراتيجيات المبيعات وتنفيذها في بيئة عمل ديناميكية. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا الدور غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على المؤهلات والخبرة. نشجع المرشحين المستوفين للشروط على التقديم.

5e6cca7a3ad4cee6.description: About the Role EMAR Saudi for Energy Works is seeking an experienced Project Manager to lead power and energy infrastructure projects across Saudi Arabia. This full-time role is based in Jeddah and Makkah, Makkah, Saudi Arabia, and involves managing EPC and turnkey projects from initiation through commissioning. The Project Manager will ensure project delivery within scope, budget, schedule, and quality standards, while adhering to Saudi regulations and client requirements. Project Focus The successful candidate will manage both Greenfield and Brownfield projects, demonstrating strong technical expertise in Protection & Control Systems, UPS Systems, Medium Voltage (MV) Switchgear, and High Voltage (HV) Substations. The role requires a proven track record of delivering projects for major Saudi utilities and industrial clients, with eligibility for approval by National Grid SA (NG). Key Responsibilities Lead the complete lifecycle of power and electrical infrastructure projects from engineering through commissioning and project close-out. Manage Greenfield and Brownfield projects involving substations, industrial facilities, utility networks, and critical infrastructure. Develop project execution plans, schedules, budgets, procurement strategies, and resource allocation plans. Coordinate engineering, procurement, construction, testing, commissioning, and handover activities. Ensure compliance with National Grid SA (NG), SEC, Saudi Electricity Code, IEC, IEEE, and client specifications. Manage project risks, technical issues, commercial matters, and contractual obligations. Monitor project progress using project management tools and prepare executive reports for management and clients. Coordinate with consultants, clients, contractors, vendors, and government authorities. Lead multidisciplinary teams including engineering, construction, QA/QC, HSE, procurement, and commissioning personnel. Ensure projects meet quality, safety, and environmental standards. Manage project cost control, variation orders, claims, and contract administration. Participate in technical reviews, Factory Acceptance Tests (FAT), Site Acceptance Tests (SAT), and energization activities. Ensure successful project commissioning and final acceptance by the client. Required Qualifications and Experience 5-10 years of experience in project management within the power and energy infrastructure sector. Approval or eligibility for approval by National Grid SA (NG). Proven experience managing Brownfield and Greenfield electrical projects. Strong technical knowledge in Protection & Control Systems, UPS Systems, Medium Voltage Switchgear, High Voltage Substations, and Testing & Commissioning. Experience leading multidisciplinary EPC project teams. Capability to manage multiple projects simultaneously while ensuring compliance with Saudi standards and client requirements. Work Location This position is based in Jeddah and Makkah, Makkah, Saudi Arabia.

5ef1869f660487e9.description: About the Role Caliberly is seeking an Operations Supervisor with 5-7 years of experience to oversee and coordinate drilling operations for geological and geotechnical projects. This contract role is based in Riyadh and Taif, with assignments primarily on Ma'aden-related mining projects across multiple locations in Saudi Arabia, including Taif and the Eastern Province. Monitor site activities to identify potential hazards and implement corrective actions. Ensure proper use of Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) by all crew members. المرافق والأشغال العامة، بما في ذلك محطات المياه والكهرباء وشبكات الصرف الصحي، بالإضافة إلى إدارة أعمال الزراعة والنظافة. يتطلب الدور خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 2-5 سنوات في مجال مشابه. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية وضع الخطط والسياسات والاستراتيجيات الإدارية العامة لمرافق الشركة، والإشراف على تنفيذها. ضمان الالتزام بقواعد الصحة والسلامة والبيئة ولوائحها، ومباشرة تنفيذها. مباشرة الأنشطة اليومية للمرافق في المنشأة، بما في ذلك المواقع المادية، والتصاميم والأثاث. تخطيط الجداول الزمنية لأعمال الصيانة والتنظيف. مباشرة أنشطة الصيانة، وتنسيق عمليات التصليح مع تقليل مدة التوقف عن العمل. اختيار الموظفين وتدريبهم والإشراف عليهم، ومراقبة أدائهم وسلوكهم مقارنةً مع الأهداف. تخطيط أعمال الإنشاء والملحقات الجديدة، وإعداد العقود المتعلقة بالبناء ومراجعتها والموافقة عليها. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة مؤهل اتخاذ القرارات الفنية وإيجاد الحلول السريعة لمشاكل العمل في الأوقات العادية والطارئة. القدرة والمهارة في التنسيق الكامل بين الإدارة وإدارة الصيانة والتشغيل الخاصة بالموقع. القدرة على حل جميع المشاكل الفنية والإدارية بالسرعة الممكنة. صلاحية اتخاذ القرارات فوراً بما يتناسب وطبيعة العمل. الخبرة في جدولة برامج الصيانة ودراسة ومتابعة المخططات الخاصة بالمنشآت. القدرة على وضع التقارير الفنية المناسبة 5e457c36d7f62683.description: About the Role Alkhorayef Petroleum Company is seeking a Lean Six Sigma Champion to lead the implementation of Lean Six Sigma methodologies within its manufacturing operations. This full-time role is based in Dammam, Eastern Region, and focuses on optimizing processes, reducing waste, and improving product quality in a high-mix, low-volume ESP manufacturing environment that includes both engineer-to-order (ETO) and make-to-order (MTO) configurations. Key Responsibilities Prepare comprehensive improvement plans, including detailed process maps, project specifications, and cost-benefit estimates for Lean Six Sigma initiatives across all 18 product lines. Contribute to new business initiatives and projects, reviewing and communicating their impact on Lean activities and operational excellence goals. Present analysis results and project solutions to technical leads, senior leaders, and clients, demonstrating measurable improvements in manufacturing performance. Develop a robust continuous improvement strategy in partnership with the Management Team and key business stakeholders, specifically addressing High Mix, Low Volume (HMLV) manufacturing challenges. Implement and support cultural change across the organization, driving business improvement through Lean Six Sigma methodologies. Develop, deliver, and support business improvement change initiatives tailored to manual manufacturing processes and diverse workforce requirements. Develop and contribute towards improvement standards in line with Lean Six Sigma best practices, specifically adapted for ESP manufacturing requirements. Undertake comprehensive business process analysis and statistical analysis for improvement initiatives, supporting wider organizational change. Lead, define, and develop continuous improvement activities designed to improve performance, including planning and executing Kaizen events, value stream mapping sessions, and SMED workshops. Perform systematic root cause analysis using Six Sigma tools such as fishbone diagrams, 5-Why analysis, and statistical analysis to resolve complex manufacturing problems. Conduct detailed value stream mapping exercises across ETO and MTO production systems to identify waste sources and improvement opportunities. Implement Lean tools including 5S, Standard Work, Visual Management, Kanban systems, and error-proofing techniques specifically designed for manual manufacturing processes. Apply Six Sigma methodologies (DMAIC, DMADV) to reduce process variation, improve first-pass yield targets, and enhance overall product quality. Establish and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) to track the effectiveness of improvement initiatives and ensure sustainable results. Experience Requirements Candidates should possess 5-10 years of relevant experience in implementing Lean Six Sigma methodologies within manufacturing environments, particularly those involving high-mix, low-volume production and engineer-to-order/make-to-order configurations. Work Environment This role operates within Alkhorayef Petroleum Company's manufacturing facility in Dammam, focusing on optimizing processes for ESP products. The position requires active engagement with various teams and stakeholders to drive continuous improvement initiatives.

5ef6d7d347649ed0.description: About JTI and the Role JTI is seeking a Commercial Planning Specialist to join its team in Makkah, with operations covering Jeddah and Makkah. This full-time position is designed for professionals with 2-5 years of experience, focusing on establishing a robust commercial data foundation and translating data into actionable business insights. Role Purpose and Impact The Commercial Planning Specialist supports the market by enhancing data quality, ensuring reporting consistency, and facilitating evidence-based decision-making. This role is critical across various commercial functions, including sales, distribution, trade activation, and route-to-market activities, by providing reliable data and analytical support. Key Responsibilities Map available market data sources and contribute to the development of a structured, documented, and scalable commercial database. Collect and consolidate data from internal systems, distributors, field teams, and approved external sources. Clean, reconcile, and validate datasets, identify gaps, duplicates, and inconsistencies, and coordinate corrective actions with data owners. Maintain data dictionaries, source definitions, naming conventions, refresh calendars, and implement basic quality controls. 5e7359b3472549e2.description: نبذة عن الدور الوظيفي نحن شركة ناشئة وطموحة في قطاع الأغذية والمشروبات (F&B) ومقرنا الرياض. نبحث عن محاسب متميز ودقيق، لديه خبرة سنتين، للانضمام إلى فريقنا وإدارة العمليات المالية اليومية وضمان دقة السجلات والامتثال للأنظمة المالية. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية القيود المحاسبية: تسجيل كافة العمليات المالية اليومية وضمان تحديث دفتر الأستاذ العام بدقة. إدارة وتقييد العقود: متابعة وتوثيق كافة عقود الشركة (موردين، إيجارات، خدمات) لضمان الالتزام بالمواعيد والمدفوعات. الامتثال للضريبة (ZATCA): إعداد وإدارة إقرارات ضريبة القيمة المضافة والتقارير الضريبية وفقاً للأنظمة المعمول بها في المملكة العربية السعودية. إتقان الإكسل (Excel): استخدام جداول البيانات المتقدمة لإدخال البيانات المالية، والنمذجة، وإعداد التقارير الضريبية. التقارير المالية: المساعدة في إعداد القوائم المالية الشهرية والسنوية. المطابقات البنكية: مراقبة ومطابقة الكشوفات البنكية والتدفقات النقدية بشكل دوري. المتطلبات والمؤهلات الخبرة: خبرة مهنية لا تقل عن سنتين في مجال المحاسبة (يفضل من لديه خبرة في قطاع المقاهي والمطاعم). المهارات التقنية: احترافية عالية في استخدام Microsoft Excel والقدرة على تسجيل القيود يدوياً بدقة. المعرفة العلمية: فهم قوي لقوانين الضريبة السعودية (VAT) ومعايير التقارير المالية الدولية (IFRS). التعليم: درجة البكالوريوس في المحاسبة أو المالية. اللغة: مهارات تواصل جيدة باللغتين العربية والإنجليزية. المهارات الشخصية: دقة متناهية، القدرة على العمل في بيئة شركات ناشئة متسارعة، ومهارات تنظيمية قوية الراتب 2000 ريال مع السكن

5eccf930941ffa77.description: Job description Why This Role Matters Exploration and Mining Artificial Intelligence is essential to improving resource discovery, orebody understanding, safety, planning, productivity, efficiency, and sustainability across Maaden’s mining operations. As Manager, Exploration & Mining Artificial Intelligence, you lead the identification, development, deployment, and adoption of AI solutions across exploration, geology, resource modeling, mine planning, drilling and blasting, material movement, fleet optimization, production, and mine safety. You translate operational challenges into scalable AI solutions and work with exploration, mining operations, technical services, engineering, OT, IT, Digital, and Enterprise AI teams to deliver measurable and sustainable value. What You Will Deliver Shape the Exploration & Mining AI Portfolio Develop and maintain a prioritized portfolio of Exploration & Mining AI use cases aligned with business strategy, site priorities, and operational performance targets. Assess opportunities based on business value, technical feasibility, data readiness, scalability, operational risk, and adoption requirements. Define clear use-case objectives, delivery roadmaps, resource requirements, benefits, and success measures. Develop and Deploy Exploration & Mining AI Solutions Lead the design, development, testing, deployment, and continuous improvement of AI, machine learning, optimization, computer vision, and geospatial analytics solutions for exploration and mining. Enable applications such as exploration targeting, geological interpretation, resource estimation support, mine planning optimization, drilling and blasting optimization, fleet productivity, ore tracking, and real-time decision support. Ensure solutions are production-ready, scalable, maintainable, explainable, and aligned with operational and technical requirements. Improve Exploration and Mining Performance Partner with exploration, geology, mine planning, technical services, mining operations, maintenance, and safety teams to identify and solve high-value operational challenges. Apply predictive and prescriptive analytics to improve discovery targeting, orebody understanding, plan compliance, equipment utilization, cycle times, material movement, productivity, and cost performance. Support hazard detection, fatigue and proximity analytics, equipment health insights, and risk-informed decision-making for safer and more reliable mining operations. Work with Enterprise AI and AI & ML Ops teams to use approved platforms, reusable components, deployment pipelines, monitoring capabilities, and model lifecycle standards. Ensure deployed models are monitored for performance, reliability, drift, availability, and continued business value. Drive Adoption and Value Realization Embed AI outputs into exploration workflows, technical services processes, dispatch and operational practices, planning cycles, and management decision-making. Lead user engagement, change management, training, and knowledge transfer to support effective adoption and sustainable operational ownership. Track realized benefits and report performance against safety, discovery, planning, production, productivity, reliability, cost, and sustainability measures. Lead Team and Capability Development Lead and develop a multidisciplinary team combining AI, data science, geoscience, mining engineering, and operational expertise. Set clear priorities, delivery standards, performance expectations, and development plans for team members. Build capability through coaching, communities of practice, external partnerships, and structured knowledge transfer. Ensure Governance, Safety, and Compliance Ensure solutions comply with safety, cybersecurity, data governance, model governance, responsible AI, quality, and operational risk requirements. Manage activities within approved scope, budget, schedule, quality, and performance expectations. Maintain accurate technical documentation, portfolio reporting, benefit tracking, and stakeholder communication. What Success Looks Like A focused Exploration & Mining AI portfolio aligned with site priorities and measurable business value. Improved exploration targeting, orebody understanding, safety, plan quality, production, equipment utilization, and mining productivity. Reduced operational variability, cycle time losses, unplanned downtime, safety exposure, and manual decision-making. Production-grade AI solutions adopted and sustained within exploration and mining operations. Reliable model performance supported by effective monitoring, governance, and operational ownership. Strong collaboration across exploration, geology, technical services, mining operations, maintenance, safety, OT, IT, Digital, and Enterprise AI. A capable and engaged team with strong AI, geoscience, and mining expertise. Minimum Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Computer Science, Mining Engineering, Geological Engineering, Geology, Geomatics, Industrial Engineering, or a related discipline. A Master’s degree is preferred. Experience 10+ years of relevant experience, (+5 of them in AI, advanced analytics), geospatial analytics, mining optimization, automation, or digital transformation, ideally within mining, metals, exploration, energy, or another asset-intensive industry. Experience leading multidisciplinary teams and delivering AI or advanced analytics solutions in exploration, mining, or operational environments. Demonstrated experience progressing solutions from use-case definition and development through production deployment, adoption, and value realization. Skills That Matter Exploration & Mining AI strategy and portfolio management Machine learning, optimization, computer vision, geospatial analytics, and time-series analytics Data Science, Artificial intelligence, machine learning, Generative AI (GenAI), optimization, computer vision, Natural Language Processing (NLP), Large Language Models (LLMs) and Agentic AI. Exploration, geology, resource modeling, mine planning, and mining operations Drilling and blasting, fleet optimization, material movement, productivity, and mine safety Predictive maintenance, equipment health, condition monitoring, and asset reliability Geoscience platforms, mine planning systems, fleet management systems, operational technology, and digital twins MLOps, model monitoring, lifecycle management, and production deployment Responsible AI, cybersecurity, data governance, and operational risk Business value realization, benefits tracking, and performance reporting Team leadership, stakeholder management, change management, and communication Preferred candidate Years of experience No experience required Degree Bachelor's degree / higher diploma

5e8a248f0a13ea28.description: Job description About the job ACCOMODATION OUTFITTING ENGINEER (CS) We are seeking an experienced Accommodation Outfitting Engineer (Construction Support – CS) with 5–10 years of experience in marine and shipbuilding projects. The successful candidate will be responsible for providing design and technical support to shipyard production teams, resolving accommodation outfitting-related construction issues, updating production drawings and 3D models, and ensuring design accuracy, constructability, and compliance with project specifications and applicable marine standards. JOB RESPONSIBILITIES: Provide construction and production support for accommodation outfitting activities in marine, shipbuilding, and offshore vessel projects. Prepare, review, and revise accommodation outfitting design deliverables, including: Accommodation general arrangement and layout drawings Cabin, bedroom, office, and living space layouts Public area, galley, mess room, sanitary space, and recreational area arrangements Interior partition, ceiling, and lining arrangements Doors, windows, access panels, and associated installation details Furniture, fixtures, and equipment (FF&E) layouts Joinery, modular furniture, and interior furnishing details Floor finishing, wall panel, and ceiling panel layouts Accommodation outfitting installation and interface drawings 2D production drawings and 3D models for accommodation outfitting systems Review shop drawings and production information to identify discrepancies and resolve design-related issues. Provide technical support to shipyard production teams during accommodation outfitting, interior installation, joinery, panel fitting, and finishing activities. Resolve technical queries (TQs), production issues, drawing discrepancies, and installation-related design problems. Incorporate engineering changes, production feedback, and redline mark-ups into drawings and 3D models. Coordinate with Hull Structure, HVAC, Electrical, Instrumentation, Piping, Fire & Safety, and other outfitting disciplines to ensure proper design integration and avoid clashes. Review vendor drawings, material specifications, furniture details, and interior outfitting documentation to ensure compatibility with approved accommodation layouts. Verify space utilization, equipment positioning, access requirements, maintainability, and installation clearances within accommodation areas. Support constructability reviews and identify potential design conflicts, installation constraints, and accessibility issues before execution. Ensure accommodation layouts and installation drawings comply with project specifications, applicable marine standards, fire safety requirements, and shipyard construction procedures. Coordinate with engineering teams, interior outfitting suppliers, equipment vendors, and production personnel to ensure timely resolution of design issues. Support the review of accommodation materials, modular components, furniture, fixtures, and interior finishing details. Ensure proper integration of HVAC diffusers, lighting fixtures, electrical outlets, sanitary systems, fire detection devices, and other services within accommodation spaces. Maintain updated production drawings, design records, and technical documentation in accordance with project procedures. Support as-built drawing updates and incorporate final production modifications, where required. Ensure construction support deliverables are completed within agreed project schedules and quality requirements. KEY QUALIFICATIONS: Diploma or Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Marine Engineering, Naval Architecture, Interior Design, or an equivalent relevant discipline. ﻿5–10 years of relevant experience in accommodation outfitting design within marine, shipbuilding, shipyard, or offshore vessel projects. Hands-on experience in Construction Support (CS), shipyard production support, and production drawing modifications. Strong experience in accommodation layouts, cabin arrangements, interior outfitting, modular furniture, joinery, and installation details. Experience preparing and modifying 2D production drawings, 3D models, interior layouts, and accommodation installation drawings. Proficiency in marine 3D design software, preferably AVEVA Marine / Hull & Outfitting, or other shipbuilding CAD software accepted by the client. Ability to interpret engineering drawings, accommodation general arrangements, shop drawings, vendor documentation, and production mark-ups. Good understanding of interior partitions, ceilings, wall linings, floor finishes, furniture installation, sanitary spaces, and accommodation outfitting components. Experience resolving technical queries and supporting shipyard production teams during construction and installation activities. Familiarity with marine classification society requirements, applicable shipbuilding standards, fire safety requirements, and project specifications. Experience coordinating with Hull Structure, HVAC, Electrical, Instrumentation, Piping, and other engineering disciplines. Understanding of accommodation service integration, space management, access requirements, and installation interfaces. Experience in new-build shipbuilding projects, offshore vessels, FPSOs, cruise ships, or similar marine engineering projects is preferred. Exposure to international shipyards, marine EPC contractors, or multidisciplinary engineering environments is preferred. Strong technical problem-solving, drawing interpretation, coordination, and communication skills. Ability to work effectively in a project-driven engineering and shipyard production environment. VERTICAL ENGINEERING Preferred candidate Years of experience No experience required Degree Bachelor's degree / higher diploma

5e5bb55d5581730d.description: About John Crane John Crane, a business within Smiths Group, is a global leader in mission-critical flow control solutions. The company serves energy and process industries, enabling efficient and sustainable operations through products such as mechanical seals and systems, couplings, filtration systems, and predictive digital monitoring technologies. The Role of Customer Reliability Engineer John Crane is seeking a Customer Reliability Engineer for a full-time position in Al Jubail. The engineer will identify opportunities for improvement, troubleshoot equipment issues, and conduct detailed analyses to enhance operational efficiency and reliability. Key Responsibilities Perform reliability analyses of customer rotating equipment, with a focus on sealing system performance and optimization. Lead and support Root Cause Analysis (RCA) investigations for sealing systems and rotating equipment, including site assessments, data collection, analysis, reporting, and presentation of findings and recommendations to customers. Conduct field troubleshooting activities, including problem diagnosis, development of corrective actions, and implementation of appropriate solutions in collaboration with customer teams. Deliver detailed technical presentations and recommendations to customers to support reliability improvement initiatives, sales opportunities, and RCA activities. Provide on-site technical support for John Crane products and assist with customer maintenance activities. Support customer sites with equipment measurements, seal installation, commissioning, and technical inspections. Ensure all work adheres to John Crane standards, procedures, quality requirements, and safety policies. Develop and maintain strong customer relationships through effective technical support and professional communication. Required Qualifications and Experience 5-10 years of experience in a relevant field. Proficiency in conducting failure analyses and reliability assessments of rotating equipment, with a specific focus on sealing systems. Demonstrated ability to identify performance and reliability improvement opportunities. Experience in troubleshooting equipment issues and conducting Root Cause Analyses (RCA) using methodologies such as Fault Tree Analysis, Ishikawa (Fishbone) Diagrams, and Apollo RCA. Familiarity with structured problem-solving techniques. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Al Jubail, requiring on-site support to external customers. The role involves working closely with customer teams and adhering to John Crane's operational and safety standards. Application Information Salary for this position will be disclosed during the interview process. Interested candidates are encouraged to apply.

5e9ad64b5ba989f9.description: About the Role Parsons is seeking a Quantity Surveyor Manager to support the Cost Manager and Controls Manager. This full-time position is based in Riyadh and is crucial for implementing robust commercial and quantity management practices across a major infrastructure program. Provide commercial and quantity analysis for internal management, cost controls, and client reporting. Participate in commercial meetings with PMCMs, contractors, and the Client, presenting QS analysis as required. Build and maintain package-level cost plans, tracking committed and actual expenditure across multiple projects. Manage variation orders, cash-flow forecasts, claims, and contractual notices. Oversee contractor, consultant, and development-partner agreements, including payment milestones and cost or profit-sharing obligations. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 10 years of relevant experience in commercial management within real estate development. Demonstrated experience in tendering, contract administration, and cost control. Proven ability to manage teams and provide commercial oversight for development projects. Work Location This position is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.

5e20bf6febdfb403.description: About the Role Azadea Group is seeking a Shop Manager for a full-time position in Jazan. This role is responsible for overseeing store operations to ensure high standards of customer service, maximize sales, and achieve profitability targets in line with company objectives. The Shop Manager also manages inventory, ensures proper maintenance, and maintains the shop's external appearance to meet brand standards. Key Responsibilities Monitor and report on customer needs, market trends, and competitor activities relevant to the region. Provide customer assistance, address inquiries and complaints, and foster customer loyalty. Ensure all store licenses, certificates, and employee documents are valid and compliant with local regulations. Manage inventory activities, including receiving, cycle counts, stock movements, transfers, damaged items, and shrinkage. Place accurate orders to meet stock performance objectives and maximize sales. Prepare staff schedules based on budgeted hours, visitor traffic, sales targets, and operational needs. Manage the allocated annual budget, monitor expenditures, optimize costs, and report variances. Oversee the shop's image, ensuring compliance with brand standards, cleanliness, display, and maintenance of all areas. Develop reports on key performance indicators (KPIs), sales trends, inventory levels, and team productivity. For Multimedia & Lifestyle: Monitor sales data to identify trends and opportunities for departmental offerings, optimizing inventory and product assortment. For Multimedia & Lifestyle: Stay informed on trends in technology, lifestyles, music, and literature to provide informed recommendations and enhance sales. Recruit, train, motivate, and evaluate the team to ensure necessary skills and optimal performance. Conduct daily meetings for staff engagement. A minimum of 2-5 years of relevant experience is required for this position. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Jazan, Saudi Arabia, within the retail sector. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

5e2ff4368307e335.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مؤسسة أريج الأولى التجارية عن مهندس أجهزة طبية للانضمام إلى فريقها في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور على تركيب وصيانة وتشخيص الأجهزة الطبية، بالإضافة إلى تدريب المستخدمين عليها. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين 2 و 5 سنوات في المجال. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية إعداد خطط وبرامج تركيب الأجهزة الطبية، مثل أجهزة التصوير الإشعاعي والموجي، وأجهزة التشخيص والمعالجة. تدريب المستخدمين على تشغيل الأجهزة الطبية بفعالية. تشخيص أعطال الأجهزة الطبية ومتابعة إجراءات الإصلاح والصيانة. إجراء الفحوص اللازمة للتأكد من دقة أداء الأجهزة الطبية. إعداد برامج الصيانة الوقائية للأجهزة الطبية وفقاً لتعليمات الشركة المصنعة ومتابعة تنفيذها. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل ومواكبة التطورات التقنية في مجال الأجهزة الطبية. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة بالأعمال والمشروعات الهندسية، وتوضيح نسب تقدمها وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المعتمدة. التعامل مع المستشفيات والمنشآت الصحية فيما يخص تركيب وتشغيل وصيانة الأجهزة الطبية. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 2 و 5 سنوات في مجال هندسة الأجهزة الطبية. فهم عميق لآليات عمل أجهزة التصوير الإشعاعي والموجي وأجهزة التشخيص والمعالجة. القدرة على تشخيص الأعطال الفنية وإجراء الصيانة اللازمة. مهارات ممتازة في إعداد التقارير الفنية والوثائق المتخصصة. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتقع في مدينة جدة، مكة المكرمة. سيعمل المهندس ضمن فريق متخصص لدعم المنشآت الصحية وضمان كفاءة الأجهزة الطبية. معلومات إضافية الراتب الخاص بهذا الدور سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات، وسيتم الإفصاح عنه خلال عملية المقابلة.

5e51c37cc30e5683.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مدارس الوطن النموذجية الأهلية عن معلم ثانوي كيمياء للانضمام إلى فريقها التعليمي في المدينة المنورة. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على تدريس طلاب المرحلة الثانوية في مجال الكيمياء، وتطوير خطط الدروس، وتقديم الدعم التعليمي الفردي والجماعي للطلاب. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تطوير خطط الدروس بما يتوافق مع المنهج الدراسي والرؤية الأكاديمية للمدرسة، واختيار المصادر التعليمية، وتصميم المواد التعليمية والدروس. تدريس مادة الكيمياء لطلاب المرحلة الثانوية، وتقديم الدروس الفردية والجماعية، وتيسير المناقشات، وتحديد الواجبات. تنظيم الرحلات والأنشطة العملية المتعلقة بمادة الكيمياء، وإدارة سلوك الطلاب وتفاعلاتهم داخل الصف. تحديد أهداف تعلم واضحة، وإعداد الاختبارات والواجبات وإدارتها، وتصحيحها لتقييم تقدم الطلاب الأكاديمي. تقديم المشورة للطلاب وأولياء أمورهم لتحسين الأداء الأكاديمي والسلوكي، وتحديد الطلاب الذين يحتاجون إلى دعم إضافي وتوفير الطرق المناسبة لتلبية احتياجاتهم. تسجيل حضور الطلاب ودرجاتهم وأدائهم الفردي، وإعداد التقارير اللازمة بذلك. حضور اجتماعات الموظفين والتنسيق الفعال مع الزملاء المدرسين والمسؤولين ومساعدي المدرسين. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في تدريس مادة الكيمياء للمرحلة الثانوية. القدرة على وضع خطط الدروس وتقديم التعليمات الفردية والجماعية. مهارات ممتازة في إدارة الصف ودعم تنمية الطلاب. بيئة العمل يعمل المعلم ضمن بيئة تعليمية داعمة في مدارس الوطن النموذجية الأهلية بالمدينة المنورة، ويكون جزءًا من فريق تعليمي ملتزم بتطوير الطلاب. نوع الوظيفة هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل. التقديم لم يتم الكشف عن تفاصيل الراتب لهذه الوظيفة. ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم.

5e78cd43e6b2406b.description: نبحث عن أخصائي مبيعات طموح للانضمام إلى فريقنا والمساهمة في تحقيق أهداف المبيعات. ستكون مسؤولاً عن تحديد فرص المبيعات الجديدة، وبناء علاقات قوية مع العملاء، وإتمام الصفقات بنجاح. إذا كنت تتمتع بمهارات تواصل ممتازة وشغف بتحقيق النتائج، فنحن ندعوك للتقديم. مهام الوظيفة: 1. ترويج وبيع سيارات الشركة إلى العملاء الحاليين وجذب عملاء جدد. 2. استقبال العملاء بشكل احترافي ملائم. 3. جذب واستقطاب العملاء على امتداد النطاق الجغرافي عبر العلاقات والمعارف. 4. بناء جسر مع العملاء وتوسعة قاعدة بيانات الشركة. 5. معرفة كافة المعلومات المتعلقة بمنتج الشركة، والإلمام التام بالمواصفات والأسعار والطريقة المثلى لتقديمه للعميل. 6. إظهار نقاط القوة والتميز في السيارات، ومعرفة الفروق بينها وبين المنافس. 7. التواصل الهاتفي مع العملاء (عبر استقبال المكالمات الداخلية أو القيام بمكالمات خارجية إن تطلب الأمر) 8. استقبال طلبات الشراء من العميل (نقدا، وتمويل) ورفع طلبات التمويل للجهة الممولة، ومتابعتها، وتحديثها بشكل دوري. 9. استلام المستندات الخاصة بعملاء التمويل وتسليمها لجهات التمويل. 10. متابعة عملية البيع مع العميل وإتمامها. 11. تحقيق هدف المبيعات الشهري المقدم له من ادارة المبيعات . 12. متابعة العميل بعد إتمام عملية البيع والتأكد من مدى رضائه عن المنتج.

5ee6a5c6b7938cb9.description: About the Role Jobmaze is seeking an experienced NOC Engineer to join their client's team in Al Khobar, Eastern Region, Saudi Arabia. This full-time position involves supporting the continuous monitoring and first-line operation of a large-scale network environment spanning multiple locations. The primary focus of this role is to maintain network availability, monitor SD-WAN and WAN infrastructure, troubleshoot connectivity issues, and provide initial incident response. Key Responsibilities Monitor and administer Cisco Meraki SD-WAN across various branch locations. Oversee and operate VeloCloud SD-WAN infrastructure. Troubleshoot Cisco switching infrastructure at HQ, warehouses, and branch locations. Monitor and troubleshoot IPsec tunnels that terminate on Fortinet perimeter firewalls. Manage SolarWinds monitoring dashboards, including alerts, thresholds, uptime, and capacity reporting. Monitor WAN connectivity across multiple Fortinet WAN links. Perform first-line triage of network incidents and escalate firewall/routing issues as required. Maintain up-to-date network documentation, including topology, VLANs, and circuit information. Follow ITIL-based incident and ticket management processes within a 24/7 NOC environment. Required Qualifications and Experience Candidates should possess strong hands-on experience in enterprise network monitoring. Proficiency with SD-WAN technologies, Cisco, Fortinet, and SolarWinds environments is essential for this role. Application Process Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted for further steps in the recruitment process.

5e8317e04f0c25e5.description: About the Role Hilton is seeking a Finance Manager to oversee all financial operations for its hotels in Dammam, Eastern Region. This full-time role involves driving financial strategy and ensuring compliance, contributing to the overall financial health and operational efficiency of the hotel portfolio. Key Responsibilities Drive financial strategy across the hotel portfolio, aligning operations with strategic goals to optimize profitability and efficiency. Oversee financial planning and analysis, including the preparation of annual plans, projections, and budgets, providing insights for business decisions. Act as the primary financial advisor to hotel management, General Managers, Owners, and Asset Managers, offering data-driven recommendations. Build and maintain strong working relationships with internal stakeholders such as Hotel Finance, Commercial, IT, Procurement, Human Resources, Operations, Shared Service Centres, and Regional Operations Finance. Ensure adherence to Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (GAAP) and hotel policies, safeguarding assets through strong financial controls within regulatory and contractual frameworks. Optimize systems and processes to enhance accuracy, efficiency, and transparency in financial reporting. Monitor and approve hotel sales, purchases, salaries, and expenses to maintain fiscal responsibility. Cultivate a high-performing team through performance management, professional development, and recognition programs. 5ec162d719ac0cfe.description: About Fluor Corporation Fluor Corporation is committed to designing and building projects and careers within a collaborative work environment. The company fosters big-picture thinking and aims to develop innovative solutions for a better world. This full-time position is based in Al Khobar, Eastern region. Role Overview: Field Superintendent I&C The Field Superintendent I&C is responsible for overseeing and directing all field construction activities for assigned craft areas. This includes ensuring work conforms to plans, specifications, schedules, and cost estimates. The role requires a strong working knowledge of assigned tasks, the ability to resolve complex situations, and the capacity to coordinate and direct construction craftsmen across multiple disciplines. This position typically manages numerous crafts, multiple areas, or large teams of craftsmen, and may involve coordinating with other contractors or subcontractors. Key Responsibilities Plan and direct work activities for all involved construction crafts, aligning with engineering deliverables, tools, equipment, and materials. Approve or authorize the coordination of craft personnel, materials, and equipment to meet project schedules. Support project and construction management in planning and utilizing appropriate means and methods for construction activities. Analyze situations, identify problems, evaluate options, and recommend/implement appropriate courses of action. Adhere to and support Fluor's Health, Safety & Environmental and Sustainability Policies. Direct and supervise Craft Superintendents, General Foremen, Foremen, and other construction supervision personnel as required by project scope. Lead construction activities involving multiple craft disciplines within assigned areas. Serve as the lead coordinator for all activities within the assigned scope in active construction work areas. Coordinate and implement internal and external support activities necessary for productive construction execution. Ensure all work is performed within approved scope boundaries and complies with project requirements, procedures, standards, and specifications. Represent the company as the senior onsite construction leader overseeing craftsmen and field activities. Qualifications and Experience Craft certification, training, and experience appropriate to the scope of assignment. A minimum of 10 years of experience in a relevant field. Ability to communicate effectively with management, coworkers, clients, vendors, contractors, and other stakeholders. Strong job-related technical knowledge required to perform assigned responsibilities. Ability to learn and apply applicable local, provincial, and national regulations, statutes, and guidelines. Strong attention to detail with the ability to work efficiently and effectively within project schedules. Proven ability to promote outstanding customer service and maintain strong client relationships. Excellent interpersonal, communication, and conflict resolution skills. Basic computer skills, including proficiency in word processing, email, spreadsheets, and presentation software. Functional knowledge of project controls, human resources, industrial relations, and contract management related to assigned responsibilities. Demonstrated strong decision-making, critical thinking, and problem-solving abilities. Thorough understanding of construction operations and related support functions. Ability to collaborate effectively and adapt to changing project conditions and priorities. Strong leadership, organizational, workforce planning, and coordination skills. Commitment to safety, quality, productivity, and successful project execution. Some locations may require additional qualifications to comply with local requirements. Work Environment This is a full-time position located in Al Khobar, Eastern region, requiring active participation in field construction activities. Application Process Candidates who meet the qualifications are invited to apply for this role.

5ee1cb5fcd0505c7.description: About the Role NES Global Talent is seeking an experienced professional for the position of Superintendent – I&C. 5e82907618dab536.description: About the Role Al-Watania Poultry (Saudi Arabia) is seeking a Maintenance Electrician to join their team in Al Qassim. 5e6c0a1078370add.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة الري للاستثمار والمقاولات عن مشرف صحة وسلامة مهنية للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يهدف هذا الدور بدوام كامل إلى ضمان تطبيق معايير السلامة والصحة المهنية في جميع المنشآت، والتحقيق في الحوادث، وإعداد الإجراءات والتقارير اللازمة للحفاظ على بيئة عمل آمنة. المسؤوليات الرئيسية متابعة تطبيق القوانين واللوائح التنظيمية والتعليمات المتعلقة بالسلامة والصحة المهنية في المنشآت. إجراء عمليات التفتيش الدورية والطارئة في مواقع العمل وتسجيل النتائج ومقارنتها بالمعايير المعتمدة. تجهيز معدات وأجهزة قياس العوامل البيئية مثل درجة الحرارة والرطوبة والضجيج والاهتزاز، وتوثيق النتائج. متابعة معالجة الأخطار البيئية الناجمة بالتنسيق مع الجهات المختصة. تحضير وتجهيز مستلزمات التحقيق في الحوادث والإصابات، وإجراء التحقيق وتوثيق النتائج. إعداد تعليمات وإجراءات السلامة والصحة المهنية، وتعليمات العمل الآمن، وتعليمات الإخلاء. توعية العاملين بالتعليمات والإجراءات الخاصة بالسلامة والصحة المهنية. إعداد وتقديم تقارير العمل الدورية وتوثيقها وحفظها. المؤهلات والخبرات يتطلب هذا الدور مرشحاً يمتلك الخبرات والمؤهلات التالية: خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال الصحة والسلامة المهنية. معرفة قوية بالقوانين واللوائح التنظيمية المتعلقة بالسلامة والصحة المهنية. القدرة على استخدام أجهزة قياس العوامل البيئية وتحليل البيانات. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات ممتازة في المتابعة والتفتيش. القدرة على التحقيق في الحوادث وتحليل أسبابها. مهارات إعداد التقارير والتوثيق بدقة. القدرة على التواصل الفعال وتوعية العاملين. بيئة العمل يقع مقر العمل في الرياض، وهو دور بدوام كامل ضمن فريق متخصص في شركة الري للاستثمار والمقاولات. تقديم الطلبات ندعو المهتمين ممن تنطبق عليهم المتطلبات لتقديم طلباتهم. سيتم التواصل مع المرشحين المؤهلين لمناقشة تفاصيل الدور.

5eb4921a2fbcee01.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مؤسسة حامد سعود العتيبي للمقاولات عن فني صيانة مبانٍ للانضمام إلى فريقها في المنطقة الشرقية. يتولى شاغل هذه الوظيفة مسؤولية دراسة خطط الصيانة الدورية، وإعداد قوائم المواد اللازمة، ومتابعة تنفيذ أعمال الصيانة الطارئة والدورية، بالإضافة إلى كيل الأعمال المنجزة وتدقيقها. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية دراسة تفاصيل خطط الصيانة الدورية لمختلف الأبنية وتحديد العيوب الفنية، ومناقشة طرق معالجتها مع المهندس المختص. إعداد قوائم بالمواد اللازمة لتنفيذ أعمال الصيانة المختلفة، بالإضافة إلى تحديد الأدوات والمعدات والعمال المطلوبين لإنجاز العمل. متابعة تنفيذ أعمال الصيانة الدورية والطارئة، والتحقق من مطابقة الأعمال المنفذة للمخططات والمواصفات الفنية. توضيح تفاصيل المخططات للمرؤوسين، ومتابعة دوام فرق العمل المختلفة، ورفع تقارير دورية بشأن الأعمال المنجزة. كيل الأعمال المنجزة وحساب كمياتها وتدقيقها، وإعداد المطالبات المالية بالتنسيق مع محاسب الكميات، وتسليم الأعمال لجهة الإشراف. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال صيانة المباني. القدرة على قراءة وفهم المخططات الهندسية والمواصفات الفنية. مهارات جيدة في إعداد التقارير والمطالبات المالية. متطلبات العمل الالتزام بخطط الصيانة الدورية والطارئة. القدرة على العمل ضمن فريق والتنسيق مع الأقسام المختلفة. الالتزام بمعايير الجودة والسلامة المهنية. نوع الوظيفة هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل، وتقدم فرصة للمساهمة في مشاريع صيانة المباني ضمن بيئة عمل احترافية في المنطقة الشرقية. معلومات إضافية الراتب سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات بعد المقابلة الشخصية.

5edc7d0fe9987b32.description: About the Role Marriott International is seeking a Guest Experience Expert for a full-time position in Riyadh. This role focuses on creating memorable and unique experiences for guests throughout their stay, extending beyond standard check-in and check-out procedures. Guest Experience Experts are empowered to provide a wide range of services, ensuring transactions are integrated seamlessly into the overall guest experience.
